$comment: PROVISIONAL SCALING FOR THE BANDED_WEIGHTED_MEAN MAPPING (CERBERUS WO-1.3).

EVERY NUMBER HERE IS A PLACEHOLDER BAND, NOT A CALIBRATED THRESHOLD. No backtest has been run (PO-DECISIONS-0025 r3: 'No weight is trusted on assertion'). They exist so a LIVE/DIRECT indicator can be scored at all and so the reading is explainable; they must be replaced by backtested values before any reading is relied on.

calm  = the indicator value that scores 0.0 (no stress). stress = the value that scores 1.0. Linear between, clamped. The ORDER of the two encodes polarity per dial; a test asserts it agrees with the ratified mapping's polarity for that dial.
weight is NOT stored here: it is derived from the ratified mapping's tier (1 -> 3, 2 -> 2, 3 -> 1).

required = true means the dial is Unknown unless this input is present and fresh. It is set only on indicators bound to ONE dial (source criticality is per source, not per dial) and only on the dial's highest-tier wired indicators. Everything else CONTRIBUTES: if absent the dial is Degraded and says which input is missing. Absence is never averaged in as zero.

Wired indicators are those the ingestion catalog delivers as a whole scored quantity (DIRECT) AND, since WO-1.5, the six DERIVED ones the ENGINE computes from stored components (crash_detector.engine.derivations). Partial, blocked and intractable indicators are PENDING and contribute nothing.

WO-1.5 DERIVED BANDS ARE THE LEAST-GROUNDED NUMBERS IN THIS FILE. They band a computed figure (a ratio, a percent, a percentile) whose historical range this project has not examined: each is a round-number guess placed within roughly +-20% of the figure's level on 2026-10-09. NO backtest, NO distribution study. Treat the resulting scores as an illustration that the wiring works, not as a reading of risk.

shiller_cape: the figure is the CAPE's PERCENTILE (0-100) within multpl's own monthly history since 1871. spx_vs_200dma: percent of the latest close above(+)/below(-) its 200-day simple average; the row's '>15% above = overextended' arm is non-monotone and cannot be expressed by a one-direction band (the declared polarity is low_is_worse), so it is NOT scored. copper_gold: HG ($/lb) / GC ($/oz) x 1000. breadth_rsp_spy, credit_stress_hyg_lqd, vix_term_structure: plain price/level ratios of same-date closes.

copper_gold is scored on the equity dial ONLY. Its monetary_debasement binding is HELD (ingestion/wiring.py HELD_BINDINGS): the ratified polarity word and the row's own comment disagree about direction. No monetary band is declared, deliberately.

WO-1.6 BANDS ARE ALSO PLACEHOLDERS: NO BACKTEST, NO DISTRIBUTION STUDY. buffett_indicator: the figure is the Z.1 ratio NCBEILQ027S/(GDP*1000) in PERCENT (255.0 for 2026-04-01; 219 for 2026-01-01); calm 100 / stress 300 are round numbers placed either side of the history this project has seen, and the ratified row's 'percentiled' step is NOT applied (ingestion/catalog.py SUBSTITUTED_FEEDS). gold_spot: the LBMA gold fix in USD/oz, banded as a LEVEL (the row says 'absolute gold trend'; no trend is computed); calm 2000 / stress 5000 brackets the futures close seen on 2026-10-09 (4216), so it is the most arbitrary band in this file. fiscal_dominance: the figure is a 0/1 flag (1 = both legs of the legacy discriminator fired), so calm 0 / stress 1 is the identity and not a calibration.

WO-1.7 BANDS ARE PLACEHOLDERS TOO (NO BACKTEST, NO DISTRIBUTION STUDY), and the three figures are Trinity's PROVISIONAL constructions, not Owner-ratified formulas. ism_manufacturing: the equal-weighted mean z-score of the Philadelphia, Empire State and Dallas surveys (0 = each at its own historical average); calm 0 / stress -1.5 are round numbers, and the row's 'below 93' arm does not apply. sloos_bank_lending: the mean of the FRED DRTSCILM C&I leg and the hand-entered NDFI leg, in net percent tightening; calm 0 / stress 40 takes the row's own '>40% net tightening preceded every recession since 1990' as the stress end. gold_real_rate_cross: the percentile (0-100) of the latest 60-day gold-vs-real-yield correlation within its ~10-year history; calm 25 / stress 90 are guesses, and the indicator has NO value while LBMA is unreachable.
